tagline: Incremental ingestion for Salesforce formula fields in Lakeflow Connect will soon be generally available.
what_it_does: Incremental ingestion for Salesforce formula fields in Lakeflow Connect will soon be generally available. Today, Lakeflow Connect ingests formula fields by taking a full snapshot on each pipeline run by default. When incremental formula field ingestion is generally available, full snapshots will no longer be the default.
why_it_matters: Incremental ingestion typically improves performance and reduces cost.
